Landed the graphics hardening work on branch graphics-hardening (off main) as a 3-commit series:
  8d37a7e  Land graphics hardening core as one green unit  (modules/graphics/**, 27 files)
  e6c74f1  Rewrite SVG backend for y-up orientation + conformance suite  (modules/graphics-svg/**, 4 files)
  715d2e5  Raise sbt JVM heap to 6g for full-suite headroom  (.jvmopts)

Verification: graphicsJVM 95, graphicsJS 95, graphicsSvgJVM 16, graphicsSvgJS 16 — all pass, 0 failures/errors on both platforms.

Deviations from the proposed 7-commit split (both permitted by the acceptance rule):
1. SQUASHED to largest green units by module boundary. The working tree held only the final flattened state, so the original per-phase history (AesEnv | device+y-up | compiler phases | guides | layout | conformance | review-fixes) could not be reconstructed as separately-compiling commits without hand-splitting interdependent modified files and risking broken bisect points. Each of the 3 commits compiles and is green in isolation (graphics/graphics-svg are self-contained leaves — graphics depends on nothing, graphicsSvg only on graphics).
2. DesignGraphics migration (phase 5) EXCLUDED — entangled with the uncommitted non-graphics DesignExports rework (DesignExportError is not in HEAD). Filed as follow-up bd-01KX31DCC34B7715GTWW68ADE3.

No unrelated files included: branch diff vs main is exactly modules/graphics/**, modules/graphics-svg/**, .jvmopts. build.sbt untouched (graphics/graphicsSvg registration + aliases already in HEAD; uncommitted build.sbt diff is other modules). All 245 unrelated working-tree paths (connectivity still staged, dataset/fit/latent/linalg/multivar/pipeline/design/archive/motion/docs) left intact. Commit messages reference the epic + this issue id.
